nodes.label: Overleaf push block
nodes.rationale: Pushes to Overleaf were refused not by git but by a Claude Code PreToolUse harness hook; the guard only sees the agent's Bash tool, which is why the human's identical terminal push succeeded.

nodes.label: block-dangerous-commands.sh PreToolUse hook
nodes.rationale: Matcher 'Bash' hook whose lines 38-48 deny `git push <remote> {main,master,defaultBranch}` with exit 2; it inspects only the command string, so it is repo-agnostic and fires across unrelated repositories.

nodes.label: Overleaf git-bridge exemption
nodes.rationale: Discriminates on the RESOLVED REMOTE URL rather than the branch name so protection for every other remote is untouched; proposed and deliberately NOT applied because it edits .claude/, which PRJ93_RULES.md puts out of bounds.

nodes.label: Overleaf single-branch git bridge
nodes.rationale: ls-remote returns only refs/heads/main and there is no pull-request mechanism, so the guard's 'use a feature branch and open a PR' remedy cannot be followed — the guard refuses permanently rather than defers.

nodes.label: Known limitation: `git -C <dir> push` falls through
nodes.rationale: The hook only sees the command string; the -C form is unparsed and hits the normal protection — failing closed, the correct direction.

nodes.label: PreToolUse deny overrides permissions.allow
nodes.rationale: A hook deny is authoritative, so adding Bash(git push *) to permissions.allow cannot fix it; the change must live in the hook.

nodes.label: PRJ93_RULES.md scope boundary
nodes.rationale: Nothing under brain/ modifies .claude/ or the root CLAUDE.md; that config is shared with a collaborator, so the fix is presented for approval only.

nodes.label: Compile-and-push rule
nodes.rationale: A landed push is part of a complete report; a guard that makes the push impossible for the agent turns the rule into one only a human can satisfy.
